thread:
marin: Quick check — racks for dedicated-capacity-3 arrived yesterday in us-west-2. Unboxed and started burn-in on 8 nodes.  
ophelia: Nice. Any hardware failures so far? timeline for making them available for reservations?  
marin: No hard failures yet. 2 nodes showing ECC warnings during the first 3-hour run; I've quarantined them and opened HW tickets with the vendor. Remaining 6 are green. Burn-in scheduled for next 24h.  
raj: Re: availability — runtime needs the latest kernel/driver combo (Linux 6.2 + NVIDIA driver 535) and a minor patch to `kv-cache` to avoid mem spikes on long seqs. I have a PR ready but want to wait for one full burn-in.  
tony: Heads-up: SRE needs telemetry hooks (gpu_temp, sm_util) exposed to prometheus before we flip canary traffic. Can we get exporters installed during burn-in?  
marin: Installing node-exporter already, will add the `nvidia-dcgm-exporter` container as part of the image. Command I used locally: `docker run --gpus all nvidia/dcgm-exporter:2.0`  
infra-bot: burnin-job-372 started on rack r3 at 1795001300, expected duration ~26h. Logs: https://ci.redwood/infra/burnin/372  
katie: Procurement note: vendor needs final acceptance sign-off to release warranty RMA for the two quarantined nodes. Who owns that acceptance?  
marin: I'll do the initial acceptance for the 6 healthy nodes. For the two with ECC — need vendor RMA approval, @katie can you coordinate on serial numbers?  
katie: Yep, I'll DM the vendor and update the ticket today. tagging invoice/po: PO-9483.  
ophelia: Ownership summary for roll-forward: marin = hardware/acceptance, raj = runtime patch + canary config, tony = SLO/alerts, katie = procurement/invoice, lina = customer reservations & billing mapping. Is that accurate?  
lina: Yes — we have a pending customer reservation (acme-inc) for 8xH100 starting in 2 weeks. We need firm availability + cost center tagging before we commit.  
raj: PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/482 — adds `kv-cache` guard and CI test. PTAL @ophelia @tony. If merged, we should bake a canary image tonight after current burn-in completes.  
ophelia: I'll review PR this afternoon. If green, let's tag a canary and route 5% traffic for 48h. Can we automate rollback to hosted models if latency regresses?	ony: Yes — we'll configure fallback policy in routing: Canary -> fallback to hosted-small if 95p latency > 400ms for 5m. I'll own the alert runbook.  
marin: One small infra snag: two racks shipped with mixed power PDUs (30A vs expected 60A). We've isolated them to avoid cross-rack power issues. Ops has been notified.  
katie: Noted — that may affect rack density math for cost estimates. I'll update the cost spreadsheet and ping finance.  
marin: Action items: 1) finish burn-in (me), 2) PR review + bake canary (ophelia/raj), 3) telemetry dashboards + fallback config (tony), 4) procurement RMA + PO tagging (katie), 5) reservation OK from product (lina).  
ophelia: I'll create a short canary plan doc and post link here by EOD.  
raj: Quick ask — can someone run `nvidia-smi -q -x | grep -i ecc` on the quarantined nodes and paste output? will help with vendor.  
marin: Paste of node-r3-05: ```<attached xml> GPU ECC Mode : Enabled GPU Current Ecc Errors (volatile): Single-bit    : 0  Double-bit    : 0```  
ophelia: Thanks — that should be enough for RMA triage.  
lina: If everything goes well, I'll tentatively approve acme-inc reservation but won't commit billing until we confirm canary SLOs pass.  
marin: Will post final burn-in results in thread when done. Ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
